observations: Pair of automotive headlight assemblies shown still wrapped in clear plastic film
Each unit has a projector-style lens with a vertical LED strip (DRL) pattern
Items sit on a tiled floor, photographed indoors with no power source visible
No brand name, logo, or part number is legible anywhere on the housings or lenses
No vehicle shown to confirm make/model fitment
Units appear unlit; no test rig or power cable visible to confirm they illuminate

claims.claim: Headlights are 'very neat as new one'
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows wrapped units from the front; no close-up of lens clarity, housing cracks, or connector condition, and no power-on test is shown

risks.risk: Lights may not power on or LEDs may be partially dead
risks.proof: Short video clip of both units connected to a 12V source showing low and high beam plus DRL lighting

risks.risk: Vehicle fitment unknown, limiting resale value if buyer's car doesn't match
risks.proof: Photo of the headlights' OEM part number sticker or a photo showing them mounted on the matching car model

risks.risk: Hidden lens cracks, fog, or moisture ingress under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each lens with plastic removed, from multiple angles
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unverified, assume minor wear

risks.risk: Missing wiring harness, bulbs, or mounting brackets
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/connector side of each unit showing bulbs and harness plugs intact

proof_requests: Video of both headlights powered on showing all functions (low beam, high beam, DRL/indicator)
Close-up photos of lenses and housings with plastic wrap removed
Photo of any part number or OEM sticker to confirm vehicle fitment
Rear-view photo showing connectors, bulbs, and adjusters present
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a pair of used projector headlight assemblies, but with no functional test, no visible part number for fitment, and the 'as new' claim unverified, it must be priced at worst case as untested, fitment-unconfirmed used parts.
